plan.question: Can an operator dynamically select candidates/resources and receive a bounded optimal quantity/route with actual directed road distances without research clutter?
plan.hypothesis: Exact small-candidate integer/route enumeration yields zero acceptance failures and dynamic controls really change computed feasible plans; product omits research sections while keeping source date/assumptions.

data.observed_truth: Previously frozen current snapshot and H13predictions; engineering exact-route oracles and directed road metadata

evaluation.success_rule: supported only if all engineering acceptance checks pass; no accuracy/effectiveness inference
evaluation.failure_rule: Any failed acceptance marksnot_supported, blockedroadsreportedwithoutfabrication; preservefailures.
evaluation.exclusion_rule: All fixed engineering fixtures tested; no outcome-based case/model selection; UI candidate decision is not training cohort selection.
evaluation.uncertainty_plan: Deterministic finite candidate engineering optimum; no population confidence interval or field causal effect.
evaluation.seed_plan: No training/new particles; reuse frozen128stationwiseparticles and deterministic tie-break.
